turn_text: I want to be judged on what I've done. And quite frankly, I've solidified myself as one of the most bipartisan members in all the Congress, and I'm really proud of that. Right now, number two, most bipartisan in all the House, of representatives out of 435 members, I'm the second most bipartisan, more bipartisan in every single Democrat and all the one Republican. And so that cuts across everything I do, because that's the foundation of how much I'm able to really have the successes I've had. I've had a total of 65 bills pass the House. and a couple of dozen of those signed into law, some by Obama and some by Trump. I'm very proud of that bipartisan record and really kind of cemented my status in the House as one of the leaders of the bipartisan movement.
